item.title: Cell-specific RNA isoform remodeling in the aging mouse brain
item.description: Single-cell long-read nanopore sequencing reveals extensive cell-type-specific RNA isoform remodeling in the aging mouse cortex and hippocampus.

item.title: Full-length direct RNA sequencing uncovers stress-granule dependent RNA decay upon cellular stress
item.description: Full-length direct RNA sequencing reveals that stress granules are hubs for selective mRNA decay during cellular stress, linking stress granule biology to RNA homeostasis.

item.title: Senescence suppresses the integrated stress response and activates a stress-remodeled secretory phenotype
item.description: Cellular senescence rewires the integrated stress response, switching cells to a remodeled secretory state that contributes to aging-associated pathologies.

item.title: Deep learning and direct sequencing of labeled RNA captures transcriptome dynamics
item.description: RNAkinet is a neural network that identifies newly synthesized 5EU-labeled RNA from nanopore direct RNA sequencing signals, enabling simultaneous profiling of RNA metabolism and regulatory elements at single-molecule resolution.

item.title: RNAkinet Published in NAR Genomics and Bioinformatics
item.description: Our deep learning tool for direct sequencing of labeled RNA, RNAkinet, is published in NAR Genomics and Bioinformatics.

item.title: Gene body DNA hydroxymethylation restricts the magnitude of transcriptional changes during aging
item.description: Gene body 5-hydroxymethylcytosine (5hmC) acts as a brake on transcriptional dysregulation during aging, restraining the magnitude of age-associated gene expression changes.

item.title: Gene Body Hydroxymethylation Paper Published in Nature Communications
item.description: Our study on how DNA hydroxymethylation restricts transcriptional changes during aging is published in Nature Communications.

item.title: Epigenomic Regulation of Gene Expression in Aging
item.description: We investigate how epigenetic marks, including DNA methylation and hydroxymethylation, regulate transcriptional homeostasis during aging.

item.title: Long-Read Direct RNA Sequencing Technologies
item.description: We develop experimental and computational technologies based on nanopore direct RNA sequencing to capture the native state of RNA in cells at single-molecule resolution.

item.title: Maragkakis Lab Joins NIA
item.description: The Maragkakis Lab, led by Dr. Emmanouil Maragkakis, officially joins the Laboratory of Genetics and Genomics at the National Institute on Aging.

item.title: RNA Metabolism in Aging
item.description: We study how RNA homeostasis is disrupted during aging, with a focus on the brain, and develop interventions to restore RNA stability and function.
